games.name: TLK Prison
games.desc:
SHUTDOWN == UPDATE
Game rule: No exploits.

Join the civilian team to prevent unwanted combat and having reset disabled.
Vote kick exploiters or server disruptors.
 
Tool info:
Taser - Ragdolls the target.
Handcuff - Disable tool usage for the target.
Rope - Ties the target who will remain immobile - they must be cuffed from behind.
Grab - Grab the target, only if they are tied or downed.  

Controls:
LeftShift to sprint
LeftControl to shiftlock
Q to throw while grabbing (Throw button)
E to dash
Q to stomp (near ragdolled/downed targets)
T to throw knife
Backspace to drop

Console:
Y to stomp
B to shiftlock
R3 to throw knife
L2 to dash
L3 to sprint
R2 to use certain tools (cuffs & special actions)
